You memorize a chapter passage by passage in order, and each day you link what you've memorized together. When you finish a chapter, it becomes one block you review in full on spaced dates set by how you rate yourself (the firmer it is, the further apart its reviews, up to two months), and you move on to the next chapter.

تقدمك بينحفظ على جهازك بس. النص المشكول.en: Your progress is saved on your device only. The vocalized text is from sunnah.com, collated word by word with the Wikisource edition, with obvious errors corrected. Every correction is recorded in the project files.

The vowel marks are the site's own, not from the print, so if you doubt a vowel, check with your teacher.

بتحفظ الباب حديث حديث بالترتيب، وكل يوم.en: You memorize a chapter hadith by hadith in order, and each day you link what you've memorized together. When you finish a chapter, it becomes one block you review in full on spaced dates set by how you rate yourself — the firmer it is, the further apart, up to two months. If you forget, reviews come closer again.

الآيات، واسم الراوي، ونص الحديث، والتخري.en: the Quranic verses, the narrator's name, the hadith text and its source (agreed upon, narrated by Muslim…).
